name: Nematic
desc: A nematic liquid crystal under a polarising microscope: the director field tangles into the classic schlieren texture where dark brushes sweep out of every half-integer disclination, birefringence washes the terraces in interference colour, and pools of isotropic melt open and re-order as the temperature drifts through the transition - each quench throwing a fresh crop of defects that hunt, pair off and annihilate; offered as crossed polars, a raw director streak field, a false-colour order-parameter map, or a blueprint of the disclination cores.

energy.doc: brightness of the brushes and how hard the aligning field twists the director

scale.doc: magnification into the cell - guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: relaxation rate, drift of the temperature field, and the polariser rotation (0.2 still churns)

density.doc: how deep the temperature swings through the transition - the amount of isotropic melt and so the defect count

order.doc: mean quench depth below the clearing point (0 = mostly isotropic and dark, 1 = a strongly ordered, brightly birefringent cell)

x.doc: pan across the cell when magnified

y.doc: pan down the cell when magnified

style.doc: aesthetic: crossed-polar schlieren texture / raw director streak field / false-colour order-parameter map / blueprint of the disclination cores

seed.doc: deterministic quench - re-throws the whole defect population
